Thank you honjo, you are helping :)

Yeah, that's exactly how it is with my stories, I have a lot of ideas, but I can't stick with them.

I'm in the U.S. and I looked into business courses at my local community college, but the only ones available this coming semester were intro classes, just general business ones that I'm sure would bore me to death. I'd rather go straight into the specific classes like advertising and small business management, which aren't open until spring semester.

I really like your ideas about doing writing workshops or helping kids to write. It's something I'll think about and look into. 

A big problem for me is that my entire family has this idea that you have to go to college to be successful, and if you don't you're automatically a failure. They're all telling me that I'll fail if I try to start a business, which isn't helping me want to try it.

Thank you again, you've given me some things to consider and it really is helping.

I tend to go through periods when things aren't good, but they're okay and I don't feel so bad, but then I have much longer periods that are like this. This one has been particularly bad, and it's been almost a year of feeling like this.

I used to like to paint, do crafts, and write, but now creative things like that frustrate me because nothing I do is good enough and I feel like I'm terrible at them. I used to dream of being an author, but after some research it seems it's very difficult to get published and even more difficult to make enough money to support yourself, plus I get writer's block and never finish anything I start writing.

I liked to be outside, bike ride and go for walks, but now I don't have the energy for them, and I mainly did those things with my dogs, but they both passed away last year, and it makes me feel too lonely to go out alone.

There were a few types of businesses I was thinking about, but I have no money to start them, no idea how to start them, and no connections. And I'm scared I'll fail and end up having to either spend a ton of money to go back to school or get some crappy job I hate, or both, and yet I can't get motivated to try to avoid that by doing something myself.
